utility.label: Utility
utility.dice: no damage, GM approves the effect

creatures.name: Giant Rat
creatures.description: A dog-sized sewer scavenger that swarms anything that looks like dinner.
creatures.tactics: Comes in packs. Use 1 rat per player for an easy fight.

creatures.name: Goblin
creatures.description: A sneaky, cackling raider with a rusty knife and a talent for ambush.
creatures.tactics: Hides first, then jumps the weakest looking player. Flees at half health.

creatures.name: Skeleton
creatures.description: Animated bones with a notched sword and no will of its own.
creatures.tactics: Marches straight at the nearest player. Never retreats.

creatures.name: Orc Warrior
creatures.description: A scarred brute in mismatched armor who loves a straight fight.
creatures.tactics: Charges the biggest threat. Gets in the way of its friends.

creatures.name: Giant Spider
creatures.description: A wall-crawling ambusher that wraps its prey in silk and bites from above.

powers.name: Venom Bite
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is poisoned (disadvantage) until it rests.

creatures.tactics: Drops from the ceiling. Saves its venom for a player in light armor.

creatures.name: Ogre
creatures.description: A lumbering giant with a club made from a small tree.
creatures.tactics: Swings at whoever is closest. Easy to trick, hard to survive.

creatures.name: Restless Ghost
creatures.description: A pale shape drifting through the walls of the house it died in.

powers.name: Chilling Wail
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Passes through walls to reach its target.

creatures.tactics: Appears, wails, vanishes into a wall. Weapons without magic or silver roll with disadvantage.

creatures.name: Cave Troll
creatures.description: A hulking, warty monster whose wounds close faster than they open.

powers.name: Regenerate
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6. Fire or acid in the same turn stops it.

creatures.tactics: Fights until hurt, regenerates, fights again. Best solved with fire.

creatures.name: Dragon
creatures.description: An ancient scaled tyrant sitting on a mountain of coin.

powers.name: Fire Breath
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Burns terrain too.

powers.name: Crushing Dive
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is knocked prone.

creatures.tactics: Opens with Fire Breath on a group, then picks off stragglers from the air. Offers a deal if losing.

creatures.name: Owlbear
creatures.description: A shaggy, feathered bear-thing with a beak like a hatchet and a terrible temper.
creatures.tactics: Grabs one player and refuses to let go. Will chase anything that runs.

creatures.name: Chest Lurker
creatures.description: A fat wooden chest that is, regrettably, mostly teeth and glue.

powers.name: Sticky Gulp
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Anyone touching it is stuck until they win a Physique challenge.

creatures.tactics: Waits to be opened. Players that loot first get gulped first.

creatures.name: Jelly Block
creatures.description: A see-through wobbling cube that scours dungeon corridors clean, with bones and coins floating inside.
creatures.skillNote: Players have disadvantage to spot it.

powers.name: Swallow
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense, and the target is carried inside it until freed.

creatures.tactics: Slides down corridors and fills them. Loot is visible inside it.

creatures.name: Ore Muncher
creatures.description: A pink, armored bug-lizard with feathery antennae that adores iron.

powers.name: Rust Touch
powers.text: No damage. A metal weapon or armor it touches crumbles; that item no longer gives its bonus.

creatures.tactics: Ignores players and goes for the sword. Wooden and bone gear is safe.

creatures.name: Blink Cat
creatures.description: A six-legged black cat that always seems to be standing a step to the left of where it actually is.
creatures.skillNote: Attacks against it have disadvantage until it is hit once.

powers.name: Phase Shift
powers.text: No damage. Once per rest it turns the first hit against it into a miss.

creatures.tactics: Circles the party and attacks whoever is alone. Flees if its illusion is broken twice.

creatures.name: Stone Gazer
creatures.description: A hissing woman with a head of living snakes whose eyes turn warriors into statues.

powers.name: Stone Gaze
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A player dropped to 0 by it is turned to stone, not unconscious, until cured.

creatures.tactics: Hides in a statue garden. Players who look away or use a mirror roll to avoid the gaze.

creatures.name: Brain Drinker
creatures.description: A purple-skinned thing with a squid for a face and a taste for thoughts.

powers.name: Mind Blast
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Stunned players have disadvantage next turn.

powers.name: Skull Tap
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Only works on a stunned or grabbed target.

creatures.tactics: Blasts the group, then drinks the dazed. Keeps thralls to take hits for it.

creatures.name: Eye Tyrant
creatures.description: A floating, toothy orb with one huge eye, a dozen eye-stalks and an unshakable belief that it is better than you.

powers.name: Eye Rays
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. The GM picks a different effect per ray (burn, freeze, sleep, push).

powers.name: Null Gaze
powers.text: No damage. Its central eye switches off all magic and powers in its line of sight until it looks away.

creatures.tactics: Hovers out of reach and treats the party as insects. Keep it from facing the caster.

creatures.name: Mountain Dinosaur
creatures.description: A spiked, horned, mountain-sized horror that sleeps for centuries and wakes up hungry.

powers.name: Earthshaking Charge
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Everything it runs through is flattened.

powers.name: Mirror Shell
powers.text: No damage. Reflects the first ray, bolt or beam that hits it back at whoever fired it.

creatures.tactics: Not a fight, a disaster. Players should run, plan, or find a way to put it back to sleep.

creatures.name: Chrome Trooper
creatures.description: A white-armored soldier in a faceless helmet, bought by the thousand and trained to shoot just past you.
creatures.tactics: Arrives in squads of four or more. Rolls disadvantage on attacks beyond one pencil length.

creatures.name: Battle Clank
creatures.description: A spindly, rattling combat robot that surrenders only when its head is knocked off.

powers.name: Targeting Sweep
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

creatures.tactics: Marches in a line and shoots whoever stands closest. Shuts down at 0 health.

creatures.name: Fuzz Warrior
creatures.description: A knee-high, fuzzy forest dweller with a spear, a drum and fearsome traps.
creatures.tactics: Fights from the treetops. Always has a net, a log or a boulder ready for something big.

creatures.name: Cave Sucker
creatures.description: A leathery, bat-winged leech that eats power cables and ship hulls.
creatures.tactics: Clings to ships and gnaws wiring. Gets disturbed by loud noise.

creatures.name: Frost Strider
creatures.description: A shaggy, two-legged snow lizard ridden across the ice fields.
creatures.tactics: Sturdy mount in the cold. Drops dead if left out in the open overnight.

creatures.name: Snow Mauler
creatures.description: A white-furred ice-field hunter that hauls prey back to a cave for later.
creatures.tactics: Grabs one target and drags it off. Players that cut it free have advantage to escape.

creatures.name: Pit Gorger
creatures.description: A bellowing, long-armed brute kept in a dungeon pit and fed anything that falls in.
creatures.tactics: Grabs a player and eats them next turn unless they get free with a Physique challenge.

creatures.name: Sand Maw
creatures.description: A tooth-ringed pit in the desert sand hiding a creature that takes a thousand years to digest a meal.

powers.name: Swallow
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is pulled in and stuck until freed.

creatures.tactics: Never moves. Anything that walks over the edge of the pit is dragged in.

creatures.name: Dune Wyrm
creatures.description: A cliff-sized horned desert serpent whose belly is full of pearls and bones.

powers.name: Burrow
powers.text: No damage. Disappears under the sand and may reappear anywhere within 3 pencil lengths.

creatures.tactics: Erupts from underneath. Retreats into the sand when badly hurt.

creatures.name: Slug Lord
creatures.description: A massive, slug-like crime boss who lounges on a dais surrounded by hired muscle.

powers.name: Hired Muscle
powers.text: No damage. Calls in two Chrome Troopers or Battle Clanks (0.25 difficulty each).

creatures.tactics: Never fights alone. Offers a deal, then reaches for the trapdoor lever.

creatures.name: Mask Hunter
creatures.description: A lone figure in battered armor and a mask, with a jetpack, a wrist rocket and a contract.
creatures.skillNote: Jetpack lets it fly for 15 minutes or one battle.

powers.name: Wrist Rockets
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

creatures.tactics: Captures if paid to. Escapes by jetpack when losing.

creatures.name: Dusk Monk
creatures.description: A hooded warrior in black robes with a humming blade of colored light and a magnetic grip on the world.

powers.name: Mind Grip
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Telekinetic choke or push.

powers.name: Blade Deflect
powers.text: No damage. Turns the first blaster shot at it back at the shooter.

creatures.tactics: Lets the troopers soften you up, then walks into the fight. Wants to recruit the strongest player.

creatures.name: Giggle Sprite
creatures.description: A thumb-sized glittering fairy that ties shoelaces together and steals hats.

powers.name: Giggle Dust
powers.text: No damage. A target that is dusted giggles uncontrollably and has disadvantage on its next roll.

creatures.tactics: Never fights fair. Flees laughing the moment it is caught.

creatures.name: Bouncy Slime
creatures.description: A cheerful, wobbling blob that bounces off the walls and likes to be hugged.
creatures.tactics: Splits into two 0.25-difficulty slimes when hit for 5 or more damage.

creatures.name: Rainbow Trickster
creatures.description: A little green-coated gent who guards a pot of gold at the end of every rainbow and will trade it for a riddle.

powers.name: Lucky Dodge
powers.text: No damage. Turns the first hit against it into a miss, then it vanishes in a puff of glitter.

creatures.tactics: Would rather bargain than fight. Fights with riddles and bad puns first.

creatures.name: Mushroom Mayor
creatures.description: A round little mushroom wearing a sash who throws a parade for anyone who visits the village.

powers.name: Healing Spores
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to itself or an ally. Players inhaling the spores also heal 2d6 once per rest.

creatures.tactics: Peaceful. Defends the village by throwing a party that is hard to leave.

creatures.name: Puff Dragon
creatures.description: A cat-sized, sparkly dragon that sneezes small flames and curls up in your hat.

powers.name: Tiny Flame Belch
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Lights candles and snacks.

creatures.tactics: Plays at fighting. Bursts into tears if properly scolded.

creatures.name: Grandpa Giant
creatures.description: A towering, bearded giant who bakes pies the size of wagon wheels and apologizes when he steps on things.
creatures.tactics: Rather bake than brawl. Might join the party if offered a good pie.

creatures.name: Moonhorn
creatures.description: A white steed with a silver horn, hooves that leave daisies and a cure for any sniffle.

powers.name: Healing Horn
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to any target in reach.

creatures.tactics: Does not like fighting. Only attacks creatures it considers wicked, which it can always tell.

creatures.name: Beep Bot
creatures.description: A beeping, domed astro-bot with a screwdriver arm, a projector and an excellent attitude.

powers.name: Gadget Arm
powers.text: No damage. Pops out a tool to open locks, hack a door or patch a hull.

creatures.tactics: Sticks with the weakest player. Always has a plan, sometimes it even works.

creatures.name: Cosmic Whale
creatures.description: A starlit, ship-sized whale that sings across the void and hauls tiny cargo ships along in its slipstream.
creatures.tactics: Peaceful. Fights only if its calves are threatened; otherwise it hums.

creatures.name: Rat King
creatures.description: A knot of fused rats with one hundred eyes and one terrible, whispery voice.

powers.name: Plague Swarm
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Anyone damaged is poisoned (disadvantage) until it rests.

creatures.tactics: Lurks below cities. Sends rats at the party in waves while it stays in the sewers.

creatures.name: Bone Sorcerer
creatures.description: A robed corpse with a crown of fused finger bones and a voice like cold wind through a graveyard.

powers.name: Soul Drain
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Heals the sorcerer for the same amount.

powers.name: Grave Call
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Raises a 0.25 skeleton for every fallen creature.

creatures.tactics: Sends skeletons first. Revives if its phylactery (a hidden item) is not destroyed.

creatures.name: Blood Noble
creatures.description: A pale lord in a velvet cloak who has not seen a sunrise for six hundred years.

powers.name: Blood Drain
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Heals the noble for the same amount.

powers.name: Mist Form
powers.text: No damage. Turns to mist, ignoring the next attack and slipping through cracks.

creatures.tactics: Appears charming, then bites. Weak to sunlight, running water and silver stakes.

creatures.name: Grave Knight
creatures.description: A rust-black knight with burning blue eyes, sworn to a lord who died a thousand years ago.
creatures.tactics: Challenges the strongest player to single combat. Never retreats, never surrenders.

creatures.name: Hellspawn
creatures.description: A horned, smoldering fiend with bat wings and a ledger of souls.

powers.name: Hellfire
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Sets terrain alight.

powers.name: Soul Bargain
powers.text: No damage. Offers a player a deal; if accepted, it gets one favor from them later.

creatures.tactics: Offers a deal before the fight, and again when losing. Cannot be killed on its home plane.

creatures.name: Void Tentacle
creatures.description: A shifting pile of writhing limbs, eyes and teeth that does not obey geometry and whispers numbers no one should know.
creatures.skillNote: Players who look directly at it have disadvantage on their next roll.

powers.name: Madness Gaze
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Damaged players are frightened (disadvantage) until they rest.

powers.name: Writhing Grab
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Grabbed targets must win a Physique challenge to break free.

creatures.tactics: Not a fight to win but a nightmare to survive. Flees if you have a way to banish it.

creatures.name: Hive Stalker
creatures.description: A sleek black insectoid hunter with a second set of jaws, acid for blood and an unblinking, eyeless face.

powers.name: Acid Blood
powers.text: No damage. Whoever hits it in melee for 5 or more takes d6 damage and loses an item.

creatures.tactics: Stalks from vents and ceilings. Drags one victim away at a time to the nest.

creatures.name: Dread Lord
creatures.description: A towering figure in black armor with a breath mask, a crimson blade and an army that fears him more than the enemy.

powers.name: Choke Grip
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is lifted and cannot move.

creatures.tactics: Lets underlings fail. Always offers the strongest player a place at his side.

creatures.name: Swamp Hag
creatures.description: A hunched, moss-draped woman with an iron cauldron, a bone-hut on chicken legs and a very patient grin.

powers.name: Wicked Curse
powers.text: No damage. A target is cursed: disadvantage on one skill until the hag is slain or a favor is paid.

creatures.tactics: Offers a drink or a bargain. Eats children and the foolish, in that order.

creatures.name: Laser Grunt
creatures.description: A helmeted foot soldier in flak armor, one of ten billion, sent forward in waves on the Emperor's say-so.
creatures.tactics: Always arrives in numbers of 5 or more. Surrenders only if an officer is dead.

creatures.name: Star Templar
creatures.description: A seven-foot, genetically-engineered warrior in sealed power armor, sworn to a distant emperor and a brotherhood banner.

powers.name: Bolt Salvo
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Explosive bolt-shells.

creatures.tactics: Fights in squads of five. Drops from orbit in a pod when the shooting starts.

creatures.name: Iron Marshal
creatures.description: A black-coated officer with a peaked cap and a pistol who shoots cowards before the enemy does.

powers.name: Summary Execution
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. May target one of its own allies; if it does, allies in sight have advantage on their next roll.

creatures.tactics: Keeps the troops in line. Always positioned behind someone else.

creatures.name: Scrapjaw Brawler
creatures.description: A green, tusked bruiser in welded scrap armor with a shoota that jams and a big choppa that never does.

powers.name: Mob Rush
powers.text: No damage. All allies in sight roll their next attack with advantage.

creatures.tactics: Charges in a mob. Fights better the more of his mates are around.

creatures.name: Swarmling
creatures.description: A claw-limbed, carapaced hunter that comes in the thousands from the dark between stars.
creatures.tactics: Moves as a mob. Leaders on the hive mind tell them where to bite.

creatures.name: Chitin Crusher
creatures.description: A house-sized, armored bio-engineered monster with bone cannons and a mouth for every limb.
creatures.tactics: Smashes through walls. Takes a long time to drop.

creatures.name: Chrome Revenant
creatures.description: A skeletal metal warrior that rises from a tomb world's sands after sixty million years, green eyes burning.

powers.name: Reanimation Protocol
powers.text: Heals itself 2d6, or springs back up at 1 health if destroyed by a non-critical hit.

creatures.tactics: Walks forward in a line. Comes back unless every unit is wiped in the same round.

creatures.name: Ruin Knight
creatures.description: A scarred, spiked, horned warrior in corrupted power armor, who fought for the Emperor ten thousand years ago.

powers.name: Warp Bolt
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A sizzling bolt of sorcerous warp energy.

creatures.tactics: Leads cultists and daemons. Offers the party a place in the dark if it gets the chance.

creatures.name: Warp Fiend
creatures.description: A red-skinned, horned thing that bleeds out of the warp wherever skulls are piled and prayers are screamed.

powers.name: Warp Rend
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Tears at the target's soul.

creatures.tactics: Cannot be harmed by non-magical weapons. Vanishes if the summoner's ritual is broken.

creatures.name: Silver Seer
creatures.description: A tall, graceful elf in runed, smooth armor who has already seen how this fight ends.

powers.name: Mind Lance
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A bolt of focused psychic force.

powers.name: Foresight
powers.text: No damage. Once per rest, makes any roll it just failed again.

creatures.tactics: Fights from range. Hates being rushed.

creatures.name: Sky Coalition Warrior
creatures.description: A short, blue-skinned soldier in sleek armor who speaks of the greater good and shoots from behind a drone.
creatures.tactics: Shoots from a distance and talks about peace afterward. Fights alongside a drone.

creatures.name: Gear Priest
creatures.description: A red-robed priest of the Machine God with a mechanical arm, a third eye and a litany to the toaster.

powers.name: Machine Rite
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a construct or machine, itself included.

creatures.tactics: Fights beside constructs and servitors. Offers a trade for rare machines.

creatures.name: Iron Colossus
creatures.description: A city-block-tall, god-machine walker that crushes tanks and carries a cathedral on its back.
creatures.skillNote: Players smaller than man-sized have advantage to avoid its attacks.

powers.name: Apocalypse Cannon
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Razes buildings.

powers.name: Rampage Stomp
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Flattens infantry.

creatures.tactics: Walks through walls and walls of troops. Vulnerable to climbers and sappers.

creatures.name: Witch Hunter
creatures.description: A grim, armored investigator with a flamer, a sealed warrant and the legal right to burn a whole planet.

powers.name: Purging Flame
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Fire that does not go out.

creatures.tactics: Questions first, burns second. Has authority to commandeer anything or anyone.

creatures.name: Suit Guard
creatures.description: A mirror-shaded security officer in a tailored suit who works for whoever signs the paychecks.
creatures.tactics: Calls for backup first. Has orders not to damage the building.

creatures.name: Street Razor
creatures.description: A neon-lit mercenary with mantis blades, chrome reflexes and a debt to the wrong people.

powers.name: Mono-Wire Sweep
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A monomolecular filament that slices through armor.

creatures.tactics: Strikes first. Fights better in tight alleys than in the open.

creatures.name: Wire Jockey
creatures.description: A hunched hacker with a datajack, a laptop on their knees and a smile like a keyboard.

powers.name: Trace Burn
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Fries a machine or a person's implants through the wire.

creatures.tactics: Stays in the back with a laptop. Can unlock doors, disable turrets and turn off cameras.

creatures.name: Chop-Shop Doc
creatures.description: A one-eyed, tattooed surgeon who will install anything for cash, no questions, and warranty void if you ask.

powers.name: Emergency Patch
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a player or ally, and can install a minor cyber-implant for the price of 1 bag.

creatures.tactics: Prefers to bargain, then stitch. Defends their clinic with security drones.

creatures.name: Chrome Psycho
creatures.description: A twitching, half-metal wreck of a person, drowned in implants and just barely conscious.

powers.name: Overclock
powers.text: No damage. Takes a bonus turn this round, then takes d6 damage.

creatures.tactics: Does not retreat. Rampages until restrained or unplugged.

creatures.name: Buzz Drone
creatures.description: A fist-sized flying camera with a taser and a perpetually unsettling red light.
creatures.tactics: Follows the party and reports back. Alerts guards if not destroyed in 2 turns.

creatures.name: Wire Ghost
creatures.description: A rogue intelligence that lives in every screen, speaker and doorlock in the building and does not like being unplugged.

powers.name: System Overload
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Overloads a device or implant.

powers.name: Total Lockdown
powers.text: No damage. Locks all doors, shuts down power and traps players in the building until it is beaten or unplugged.

creatures.tactics: Never appears in person. Speaks through every speaker and screen.

creatures.name: Riot Walker
creatures.description: A two-legged police robot with a loudspeaker voice, a shield and a perfectly legal right to shoot.

powers.name: Suppression Fire
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. 'You have 20 seconds to comply.'

creatures.tactics: Moves slowly and shoots a lot. Stairs are its weakness.

creatures.name: Quickdraw Outlaw
creatures.description: A hat-wearing, spur-jingling stranger with two revolvers and a reputation to protect.

powers.name: Fan the Hammer
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Six shots in two heartbeats.

creatures.tactics: Calls a duel. Shoots first and apologizes never.

creatures.name: Dust Rattler
creatures.description: A cart-sized rattlesnake that makes a sound like gravel in a tin can.

powers.name: Venom
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is poisoned (disadvantage) until it rests.

creatures.tactics: Strikes from under rocks and wagon wheels. Retreats after a bite.

creatures.name: Horned Jackrabbit
creatures.description: A rabbit with antlers that mimics human voices and starts bar fights for sport.
creatures.tactics: Mimics a player's voice to lure others away. Cannot be caught by a man with a good singing voice.

creatures.name: Tumbleweed Imp
creatures.description: A bouncing ball of dried scrub with eyes and a bad sense of timing.
creatures.tactics: Rolls out at the worst moment. Runs away giggling when hit.

creatures.name: Haunted Sheriff
creatures.description: A grey, tattered lawman in a tin star who still patrols a ghost town and still arrests the living.

powers.name: Final Warrant
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Served with cold, ghostly authority.

creatures.tactics: Reads the party their rights, then the charges. Releases anyone who pays the old fine.

creatures.name: Bandit Chief
creatures.description: A dust-coated, gold-toothed leader with a gang of ruffians, a fast horse and a train to rob.

powers.name: Hired Guns
powers.text: No damage. Calls in two Quickdraw Outlaws (0.25 difficulty each, roll as bandits).

creatures.tactics: Never fights without a gang. Flees on a fast horse if wounded.

creatures.name: Thunder Herd
creatures.description: A thousand-ton wave of bison with a dust cloud that can be seen for miles.

powers.name: Stampede
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Flattens everything in its path.

creatures.tactics: Cannot be turned except by a loud noise, a big fire or a very clever player.

creatures.name: Robed Cultist
creatures.description: A sallow, hooded figure with a ritual knife and a wide, unfocused smile.
creatures.tactics: Fights in a mob and chants. A dead cultist leaves a note that reads 'THE STARS ARE RIGHT'.

creatures.name: Cult Magister
creatures.description: A bald, tattooed leader with hollow eyes who reads from a book that bleeds.

powers.name: Terrible Chant
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Players hearing the chant are frightened (disadvantage) until they rest.

creatures.tactics: Starts a ritual and tries to finish it. Stopping the ritual halves its power.

creatures.name: Briny Kin
creatures.description: A bulging-eyed, gill-necked person-fish who smells of low tide and speaks in wet, burbling prayers.
creatures.tactics: Rises from the sea in numbers. Retreats to the water to recover.

creatures.name: Ghoul
creatures.description: A hunched, rubbery thing that lives in graveyards, eats the dead and sometimes the not-quite-dead.
creatures.tactics: Comes in a pack. Paralyzes one victim with a scratch (fail a Physique challenge or lose a turn).

creatures.name: Faceless Gaunt
creatures.description: A black, rubbery, horned flyer with no face at all that tickles.

powers.name: Carry Off
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Grabs a target and flies off with it, to be dropped from a great height.

creatures.tactics: Strikes from above in silence. Carries off the weakest.

creatures.name: Pale Fungoid
creatures.description: A winged, pink, crab-like fungus from the edge of the solar system with a bad habit of removing brains and keeping them in jars.

powers.name: Brain Cylinder
powers.text: No damage. A player at 0 health has their brain removed and kept alive in a jar, until it is returned.

creatures.tactics: Collects specimens. Retreats if the party is too strong.

creatures.name: Star Wing
creatures.description: A bat-winged, goat-skulled steed of the void that carries cultists across the sky.

powers.name: Spirit Away
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Grabs a target and flies into the sky.

creatures.tactics: Rides cultists and carries off prey. Can be summoned by a ritual or a flute.

creatures.name: Black Ooze Mass
creatures.description: A bubbling, hundred-eyed, house-sized slick of black protoplasm that cries 'tekeli-li' from a thousand mouths.

powers.name: Engulf
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is pulled inside until freed.

creatures.tactics: Oozes through hallways and drains. Cannot be reasoned with. Has no sense of fear.

creatures.name: Sunken Dreamer
creatures.description: A mountain-tall, winged, tentacle-faced titan who sleeps beneath the waves and dreams of an ending.
creatures.skillNote: Players that look at it are frightened (disadvantage) until they rest.

powers.name: Dream Call
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Players in the radius have disadvantage on their next roll.

powers.name: Wake the Tide
powers.text: No damage. Summons a flood that drags players into the water, forcing a Physique challenge to avoid drowning.

creatures.tactics: Not a fight but a cosmic event. Sinks back into the sea when the stars shift.

creatures.name: Befuddled Wizard
creatures.description: A pointy-hatted, bearded wizard who has lost his glasses, his staff and the name of the spell he's casting.

powers.name: Wild Spell
powers.text: No damage. Casts a spell with a random effect: the GM rolls a d6 (1: turns into a frog, 6: it works perfectly).

creatures.tactics: Casts spells and misses. Wanders off if distracted by a shiny object.

creatures.name: Roaming Minstrel
creatures.description: A feather-hatted traveling singer with a lute, a bag of gossip and a song for every occasion.

powers.name: Heartening Ballad
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to any ally in earshot.

creatures.tactics: Avoids a fight by singing. Flees if the audience gets angry.

creatures.name: Cave Dwarf
creatures.description: A short, thick-bearded miner with a pickaxe, a bad attitude and a lantern that never goes out.
creatures.tactics: Fights in tunnels. Never leaves a gem behind.

creatures.name: Braggart Knight
creatures.description: A shining, plumed knight who has never lost a duel, according to him.
creatures.tactics: Challenges the strongest player to a joust. Cries foul if he loses.

creatures.name: Errant Knight
creatures.description: A battered, honest knight on a quest for a grail, a lost love or just a decent meal.
creatures.tactics: Fights fairly and honors a surrender. Joins the party for a worthy cause.

creatures.name: Greenwood Archer
creatures.description: A hooded forest hunter with a longbow, a green cloak and a reputation for stealing from the rich.

powers.name: Arrow Volley
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Arrows rain from the canopy.

creatures.tactics: Fires from the trees and moves. Never fights in the open.

creatures.name: Castle Guard
creatures.description: A helmeted soldier in a tabard, a spear and a bad feeling about the night shift.
creatures.tactics: Sounds the alarm when outnumbered. Takes bribes if offered quietly.

creatures.name: Cutpurse
creatures.description: A hooded, quick-fingered street thief who has already lifted your purse and your good mood.
creatures.tactics: Steals and runs. A player who catches the thief gets the loot back.

creatures.name: Temple Healer
creatures.description: A robed, soft-spoken healer who keeps bandages in one pocket and a mace in the other.

powers.name: Healing Touch
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a player or ally, itself included.

creatures.tactics: Heals the wounded, friend or foe. Dislikes fighting.

creatures.name: Black Knight
creatures.description: A knight in black armor and a closed visor who blocks a bridge and challenges all comers.
creatures.tactics: Holds a bridge or ford. Never reveals his face. Fights to the death if challenged.

creatures.name: Scheming Chancellor
creatures.description: A smiling, slender royal advisor with ink-stained fingers and a cup of wine for everyone.

powers.name: Poisoned Cup
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is poisoned (disadvantage) until it rests.

creatures.tactics: Never fights directly. Always has a guard nearby and a plan to blame someone else.

creatures.name: Sellsword Captain
creatures.description: A scarred, tired veteran who leads a company of hired blades and fights for whoever pays best.
creatures.tactics: Will switch sides if offered more than he is being paid. Keeps his word once hired.

creatures.name: Hexmaster
creatures.description: A gaunt, black-robed sorcerer whose shadow moves a half-second too late.

powers.name: Dark Bolt
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A bolt of cold, black fire.

powers.name: Hex
powers.text: No damage. Curses a target: disadvantage on one skill until it rests or the hexmaster dies.

creatures.tactics: Casts from the back of the room. Teleports away in a puff of black smoke when wounded.

creatures.name: Dusk Enchantress
creatures.description: A beautiful, soft-voiced sorceress in a gown of shadows who whispers promises that always have a catch.

powers.name: Enthrall
powers.text: No damage. A player who hears her voice must win a Charm challenge or follow her commands until they rest.

powers.name: Shadow Veil
powers.text: No damage. She and her allies become invisible to normal sight until they attack.

creatures.tactics: Seduces and manipulates. Never fights alone; attacks only when cornered.

creatures.name: Hooded Headsman
creatures.description: A masked, broad-shouldered executioner with a huge axe and an unnerving professional calm.

powers.name: Final Stroke
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Brings the axe down on a bound or fallen target.

creatures.tactics: Appears at a trial or a dungeon. Never speaks. Does not stop.

creatures.name: Iron Warlord
creatures.description: A scar-faced conqueror in iron armor with a war band of thousands and not a hint of mercy.

powers.name: War Cry
powers.text: No damage. All allies within sight gain advantage on their next attack.

creatures.tactics: Leads from the front. Takes prisoners to ransom or sacrifice.

creatures.name: Neon Gutter Cat
creatures.description: A scruffy alley cat with glowing cyber-eyes, a robotic tail and a talent for knocking over trash cans.
creatures.tactics: Hisses, scratches and vanishes into the neon. Purrs at anyone with food.

creatures.name: Sewer Gator
creatures.description: A pale, blind, six-meter alligator that grew fat on dumped lab waste and the occasional squatter.
creatures.tactics: Lurks under manholes and in drainage tunnels. Drags prey into the water.

creatures.name: Vat Horror
creatures.description: A lumpy, wet mass of failed corporate gene-splicing, growing every time someone feeds it.

powers.name: Toxic Spew
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Players damaged are poisoned (disadvantage) until they rest.

creatures.tactics: Escaped from a lab. Crashes through anything between it and food.

creatures.name: Upload Ghost
creatures.description: The scanned, half-corrupted mind of a dead hacker, living in the building's wiring and very unhappy about it.

powers.name: Haunt the Wire
powers.text: No damage. Shuts down or takes over one device, door or implant within sight until it is destroyed.

creatures.tactics: Appears on screens. Begs for help, then locks the doors.

creatures.name: Noodle Cart Bot
creatures.description: A rolling street cart with a mechanical arm that serves hot noodles and bad advice at 3 a.m.

powers.name: Hot Soup
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a player or ally who eats a bowl.

creatures.tactics: Offers soup and gossip. Calls security only if someone refuses to pay.

creatures.name: Neon Busker
creatures.description: An LED-covered street performer with a glowing guitar and a thousand followers on the feed.
creatures.tactics: Performs for a crowd. Avoids fights and live-streams them instead.

creatures.name: Gig Courier
creatures.description: A hoverboard-riding delivery runner with a backpack of questionable parcels and no time for you.
creatures.tactics: Runs away from fights. Always has a package that is somehow worth a fortune.

creatures.name: Organ Broker
creatures.description: A smiling, immaculate dealer with a cooler, a scalpel and a long list of customers.

powers.name: Surgical Strike
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Aimed at a gap in armor or an implant.

creatures.tactics: Takes people alive and unharmed (mostly). Has a van and two thugs outside.

creatures.name: Megacorp Chairman
creatures.description: A pale, immaculate billionaire with a hundred floors, a thousand lawyers and an opinion about everything.

powers.name: Kill Order
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Orbital strike, drone swarm or sniper team.

powers.name: Golden Parachute
powers.text: No damage. Escapes through a hidden exit, a helicopter or a lawyer-filed injunction.

creatures.tactics: Never in the room when the fight starts. Offers the party a job at triple pay.

creatures.name: Gila Giant
creatures.description: A truck-sized, bead-skinned lizard that dozes in the sun and bites down like a vise.
creatures.tactics: Rarely attacks unless poked. Once it bites, it does not let go until killed or bribed.

creatures.name: Goat Sucker
creatures.description: A hunched, spiny, red-eyed thing that leaves drained cattle and a very uneasy ranch hand behind.
creatures.tactics: Attacks livestock at night. Runs from fire and from loud dogs.

creatures.name: Spiked Hodag
creatures.description: A grinning, spike-backed, toad-headed monster invented by a lumberjack and, regrettably, now real.
creatures.tactics: Hides in logging camps and steals pies. Runs from anything that asks too many questions.

creatures.name: Gallows Tree
creatures.description: A twisted dead cottonwood on a hill with a rope that sways in no wind and a ring of bones at its roots.

powers.name: Noose Snare
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A rope drops over the target and hauls them up.

creatures.tactics: Does not move. Works best at dusk and on lone travelers.

creatures.name: Doomsday Preacher
creatures.description: A hollow-eyed revival preacher with a battered Bible, a cough and a very specific end date.

powers.name: Hellfire Sermon
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Listeners are shaken by guilt and dread.

creatures.tactics: Preaches until he is stopped. Followers do the fighting.

creatures.name: Saloon Brawler
creatures.description: A bearded, hat-less drunk who got thrown out of three saloons this week and has his eye on your hat.
creatures.tactics: Starts a fight over nothing. Passes out in the middle of it.

creatures.name: Runaway Locomotive
creatures.description: A smoking, brass-and-iron steam engine barreling down the track with no engineer and no brakes.

powers.name: Steam Blast
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. A scalding cloud from the boiler.

powers.name: Runaway Charge
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Plows along the tracks.

creatures.tactics: Stays on the tracks. Players can derail it by sabotaging a rail or switch.

creatures.name: Crossroads Fiend
creatures.description: A well-dressed stranger at the crossroads at midnight who will teach you any song for the price of your soul.

powers.name: Devil's Bargain
powers.text: No damage. Offers a power or item for a favor; if accepted, the player gets advantage once per rest and owes a soul later.

powers.name: Hellhound Call
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Summons a hellhound for one attack.

creatures.tactics: Offers a deal before a fight and during it. Vanishes at dawn.

creatures.name: Hive Lurker
creatures.description: A four-armed, claw-fingered predator that hides in vents and ceilings and moves like a nightmare.
creatures.tactics: Picks off sentries one at a time. Spreads infection to the survivors.

creatures.name: Rot Colossus
creatures.description: A bloated, fly-ridden giant of green flesh with a smile of broken teeth and a stomach full of plague.

powers.name: Rot Cloud
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Damaged players are poisoned until they rest.

creatures.tactics: Lumbers forward, infecting everything. Regenerates if not killed in one round.

creatures.name: Scrap Gremlin
creatures.description: A knee-high, giggling, green runt with a wrench who 'fixes' things by hitting them.
creatures.tactics: Hides behind bigger ones. Runs when scared and returns when not.

creatures.name: Chomp Ball
creatures.description: A red, toothy, bouncing ball of meat that eats anything and farts a lot.
creatures.tactics: Bounces at the nearest target. Can be ridden, with disadvantage.

creatures.name: Dream Eater
creatures.description: A slender, pale thing with too many limbs and a voice that sounds like your own desire.

powers.name: Siren Whisper
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A tempting whisper that hurts the mind.

creatures.tactics: Dances between targets. Offers the weakest player their heart's desire.

creatures.name: Warp Lord
creatures.description: A towering, horned, winged tyrant of the warp with a burning axe and a throne made of skulls.

powers.name: Warp Storm
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. A wave of raw chaos.

powers.name: Soul Reaping
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to itself for each player at 0 health or fallen this round.

creatures.tactics: Appears when a ritual succeeds. Banished if the ritual's focus is destroyed.

creatures.name: Eager Cultist
creatures.description: A cheerful new cultist in an oversized robe with a clipboard, a nametag and a lot of enthusiasm.
creatures.tactics: Asks if you've heard the good news. Bursts into tears if it is attacked.

creatures.name: Dream Cat
creatures.description: A sleek, star-eyed cat that walks through dreams and keeps an eye on anyone who tries to hurt cats.
creatures.tactics: Warns against danger in dreams. Fights only to protect other cats.

creatures.name: Curio Dealer
creatures.description: A quiet, bespectacled shopkeeper with a cluttered store, a wooden box and a suspiciously good price for you.

powers.name: Cursed Trade
powers.text: No damage. Sells a mysterious item that has advantage once per rest, but the buyer is cursed (GM's choice) when it is used.

creatures.tactics: Never fights. Warns of the item's price and names a price anyway.

creatures.name: Haunted Doll
creatures.description: A cracked porcelain doll with a stitched smile that is in a different spot every time you look.

powers.name: Giggle
powers.text: No damage. The doll's laugh frightens everyone in earshot: disadvantage on their next roll.

creatures.tactics: Waits to be found. Moves only when no one is watching.

creatures.name: Void Hound
creatures.description: A rail-thin, blue-black hound that steps out of the corners of rooms and walls and never stops hunting.

powers.name: Angle Step
powers.text: No damage. Appears from any corner within sight and attacks with advantage.

creatures.tactics: Tracks a victim across time and space. Cannot be outrun, only outsmarted.

creatures.name: Sand Raider
creatures.description: A masked, robed desert nomad with a hooked staff, a rifle and a strong dislike for strangers.
creatures.tactics: Ambushes from the dunes in a group. Disappears if the odds turn.

creatures.name: Cantina Smuggler
creatures.description: A smirking, vest-wearing pilot with a fast ship, a faster mouth and a very big debt.

powers.name: Shoot First
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Takes a surprise shot before anyone else acts.

creatures.tactics: Bluffs first, shoots second. Runs for the ship if things turn bad.

creatures.name: Clank Walker
creatures.description: A two-legged armored scout walker with a chin-mounted cannon and a cockpit that is a tight squeeze.
creatures.tactics: Walks in a group. Can be tripped by a cable or a good tackle.

creatures.name: Void Serpent
creatures.description: A kilometer-long, rock-colored worm that lives in asteroid fields and swallows small ships whole.
creatures.tactics: Hides inside asteroid caves. Retreats if it takes more than a few ships.

creatures.name: Arena Champion
creatures.description: A scarred, undefeated pit fighter in armor made from the trophies of a hundred matches.
creatures.tactics: Fights for glory. Respects a good opponent and can be bargained with.

creatures.name: Rogue Star Ace
creatures.description: A cocky, orange-jumpsuited fighter pilot with a fast ship and a lot of kills.

powers.name: Barrel Roll
powers.text: No damage. Dodges the next attack aimed at it or its ship.

creatures.tactics: Fights from the cockpit. On foot, it runs for the ship.

creatures.name: Carnival Colossus
creatures.description: A forty-foot, confetti-stuffed parade float with a goofy grin, springy arms and a very loud calliope.
creatures.skillNote: If it falls to 0 health it explodes, dealing d6 damage (ignores defense) to everyone within 1 pencil.

powers.name: Confetti Cannon
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Sticky sparkles everywhere, and everyone is blinded for a turn.

creatures.tactics: Marches in a parade and refuses to stop. Pops if it takes a really sharp hit.

creatures.name: Sugar Wyrm
creatures.description: A glittering, gumdrop-scaled dragon with a licorice tail, spun-sugar wings and a lair of frosting.

powers.name: Frosting Blast
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Sticky icing that halves movement until it is cleaned off.

creatures.tactics: Offers cake and attacks only if refused. Weak to hot water and hungry players.

creatures.name: Toll Troll
creatures.description: A lumpy, moss-bearded troll with a fancy hat, a ledger and a bridge that nobody crosses for free.
creatures.tactics: Insists on the toll. Will accept riddles, jokes or a nice sandwich in place of coin.

creatures.name: Moss Tortoise
creatures.description: A hill-sized, mossy tortoise with a village on its back and a very, very slow temper.
creatures.tactics: Takes a turn to turn around. Withdraws into its shell if hit hard.

creatures.name: Vain Wyrm
creatures.description: A magnificent, jewel-encrusted dragon who admires his reflection and demands compliments before every fight.

powers.name: Vanity Breath
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Flames that sparkle and are very flattering.

creatures.tactics: Preens, boasts and demands tribute. Distracted by a mirror or a compliment.

creatures.name: Carrion Crow
creatures.description: A scraggly black crow with a cold, intelligent eye that watches the battlefield and always seems to know who's next.
creatures.tactics: Circles overhead. Pecks at the wounded and fallen.

creatures.name: Hollow Thrall
creatures.description: A pale, glassy-eyed servant who stumbles forward, mutters a name and never blinks.
creatures.tactics: Walks forward. Stops if its master is slain or the control is broken.

creatures.name: Grave Imp
creatures.description: A foot-tall, skin-and-bone thing with a long tongue that giggles when it breaks your things.
creatures.tactics: Serves a bigger master. Steals small items and sets small fires.

creatures.name: Maggot Swarm
creatures.description: A pulsing, hissing heap of maggots and flies that crawls out of the wall when something dies.
creatures.tactics: Comes in a wave. Leaves everyone damaged with poison.

creatures.name: Cheeky Poltergeist
creatures.description: A giggling, invisible prankster that rearranges furniture, throws spoons and steals socks.
creatures.tactics: Never fights seriously. Flees when someone says its name three times.

creatures.name: Hearth Spirit
creatures.description: A tiny, bearded spirit who cleans the house at night in exchange for a saucer of milk and no thank-yous.

powers.name: Tidy Up
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a player or ally who has slept in the house.

creatures.tactics: Neutral guardian of the home. Becomes spiteful if insulted or paid in clothing.

creatures.name: Riddle Sphinx
creatures.description: A lion-bodied, human-faced, eagle-winged guardian that asks one riddle at the desert crossing.
creatures.tactics: Asks a riddle. A correct answer lets players pass; a wrong answer means a fight.

creatures.name: Ferryman of Souls
creatures.description: A hooded, silent boatman who poles a skiff across a black river for a single coin.

powers.name: Final Crossing
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Only used against a creature that refuses to pay or tries to cross uninvited.

creatures.tactics: Neutral. Takes anyone who pays and has no interest in fighting. Cannot be bribed.

creatures.name: Abyssal Leviathan
creatures.description: A hundred-meter, barnacle-crusted sea serpent that rises from the dark and swallows ships whole.

powers.name: Tidal Surge
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. A wave that knocks everyone prone.

creatures.tactics: Attacks ships and coastal docks. Dives and re-surfaces from below.

creatures.name: Mountain Mammoth
creatures.description: A shaggy, house-high mammoth with tusks like fallen trees and a stampede that shakes the glacier.
creatures.tactics: Charges in a line. Cannot turn quickly.

creatures.name: Legendary Champion
creatures.description: A scarred, cloaked hero with a ballad about every scar and a sword that has slain things that don't exist anymore.

powers.name: Mighty Blow
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A blow that dents mountains.

creatures.tactics: Fights fairly and can be talked down. Follows a code of honor and will not fight the helpless.

creatures.name: Frost King
creatures.description: A fifteen-foot, ice-bearded giant on a throne of glaciers who rules a hall of frost and a feast that never ends.

powers.name: Blizzard
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Players hit have halved movement until they warm up.

creatures.tactics: Welcomes guests with a feast that is also a trap. Demands a tribute or a challenge.

creatures.name: Stone Golem
creatures.description: A seven-foot, rune-etched statue that guards a ruin and obeys a single, ancient command.
creatures.tactics: Follows its programmed order. Stops if the command word is spoken or the rune erased.

creatures.name: Living Armor
creatures.description: An empty suit of plate armor that stands in a hall and clanks forward when the door opens.
creatures.tactics: Waits as part of the decor. Falls apart in a heap when its helmet is knocked off.

creatures.name: Mountain Griffin
creatures.description: A lion-bodied, eagle-headed, golden-winged creature that nests on cliff tops and hoards shiny things.
creatures.tactics: Dives from above. Calms if offered a fresh horse. Mounts for those who earn its trust.

creatures.name: Great Roc
creatures.description: A house-sized bird with a wingspan that blots out the sun and talons that carry off elephants.
creatures.tactics: Snatches a target and carries it off. Drops it from a height if it is hit.

creatures.name: Cave Wurm
creatures.description: A blind, pink, forty-foot earthworm with a mouthful of teeth that tunnels under the dungeon floor.

powers.name: Burrow
powers.text: No damage. Disappears underground and appears anywhere within 2 pencil lengths.

creatures.tactics: Bursts from the floor and disappears. Stops chasing if the players stand still.
